title: Third-Order Local Randomized Measurements for Finite-size Entanglement Certification
summary: Randomized measurements access nonlinear functionals without full tomography, yet turning third-order local single-copy data into a strong entanglement test remains difficult. We convert the reduction criterion into an experimentally measurable separability criterion by testing it on squared affine combinations of the identity, the local marginals, and the state itself. This yields a $4\times4$ matrix $\bar{\mathfrak{M}}(ρ)$ built from experimentally accessible second- and third-order local invariants. Entanglement is certified when its minimum eigenvalue $\mathcal{E}_4(ρ)$ becomes negative.…
